status: Source and symbol audit for pending native text integration; no Firefox text adapter is implemented.

replace_action.symbol: EditorBase::ReplaceTextAsAction(nsAString const&, nsRange*, AllowBeforeInputEventCancelable, PreventSetSelection, nsIPrincipal*)

findings.finding: Text controls inherit ScrollContainerFrame and render anonymous contents. Theme border/background replacement alone cannot make the field editor native.
The existing engine creates an insert-text action, dispatches beforeinput, checks cancellation and uses its existing transaction batch.
Native semantic deletion commands must connect to the corresponding engine action and preserve native proposed ranges; ordinary engine geometry alone does not establish native editing behavior.
The autocomplete-style user-value path clears the read-only flag, removes maximum length and replaces the value through ReplaceTextAsAction. It is unsuitable as a generic ordinary typing adapter.
Replacement is a distinct edit action with its own beforeinput data and selection behavior; a whole-value setter cannot stand in for every native editor operation.

remaining: Audit exact text state/editor/node/selection layouts, structure returns and complete function signatures before using these symbols.
Guard instruction bytes and source/build identity for every activated detour. Symbol addresses alone are not an activation guard.
Bind actual engine insert/delete/paste/undo and beforeinput/input/change transactions to native proposals, including cancellation and reentrant script mutation.
Own complete anonymous editor display/selection/caret suppression only after native content and input are prepared.
Qualify native selection, maxlength/read-only/disabled behavior, composition, trusted events, clipboard events, undo, destruction/navigation and failure recovery.
Browser URL bars, frontends, derivative-specific interfaces, other builds and the remaining non-GNUstep apps remain separate integration work.
